description: List the perfumes the user rated on their own Parfumo account, one rating scale at a time (scent by default; longevity, sillage, bottle, value_for_money), newest first or sorted by rating. Returns a paginated list with the perfume `id` and the rating out of 10. For all five ratings of the perfumes of a collection list, parfumo_get_collection is quicker. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: the `next_cursor` of the previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 25, maximum 100).

scale.description: Which rating scale to list (default `scent`). Parfumo lists one scale at a time.

name: parfumo_list_my_ratings

RatedPerfume.description: A perfume the member rated on one scale ("My Ratings" page).

perfume_id.description: Perfume identifier usable with every perfume tool (`Brand/Perfume`).

rated.description: When it was rated, as shown by the site (relative, e.g. `3 days ago`).

rating.description: The member's rating on the scale of the page, out of 10.

items.description: Perfumes the member rated on this scale.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the following items. Absent when there is nothing more.

total_items.description: Number of perfumes rated on this scale, when the site states it.
